The props-lab operates under a dual logic: hypothesis generation and null validation. Each primitive encodes a statistical model with specific assumptions about player behavior, environmental influence, and game structure. The Cold-Wind model uses logistic regression to estimate pass completion under adverse conditions, while the Revenge model isolates behavioral shifts through fixed-effects regression. The Hierarchical Pooled test applies Bayesian shrinkage to aggregate effects across game states. All models are evaluated via out-of-sample validation, with null hypotheses rejected based on likelihood thresholds. The lab’s closure rules ensure that only robust, reproducible signals propagate to GSI and GSE. The engine gate ensures that findings must be vetted by decision authority before deployment. This process enforces epistemic rigor over speculative edge-finding.
